signal: Haus raised a $17M Series A led by Insight Partners and published a survey showing half of marketing leaders cannot explain their ROI measurement

email.body1:
Taylor, saw Haus raised its $17M Series A from Insight and dropped that survey on marketing ROI confidence.

A raise plus a sharp piece of demand-gen usually creates more in-market advertisers than the team can cover before the interest cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Haus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Taylor, quick follow-up for Haus.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap surfaces late, and recovering the quarter gets hard.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Haus needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Taylor, last bit of proof for Haus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Haus' reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Taylor, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I will tailor it to Haus either way.
